name: dumbbell bench supported external rotation
description: A light shoulder external rotation with the working upper arm supported on an incline bench while standing beside it.
instructions: Stand beside an incline bench and rest your working upper arm or elbow on the bench at a comfortable height.
Hold a light dumbbell with your elbow bent about 90 degrees and your forearm pointing down.
Keep the upper arm supported as you rotate the forearm upward from the shoulder.
Lower slowly and switch arms after the set.
